summary: Accepted for WI #3325 at source digest sha256:fe582673eda5d18b7e84e5b8e2488271cea37e4197563fe789a3a184b4c581b0. The readiness contract independently derives current source identity, executes a non-empty verifier, compares the exact shared capability/health projection, mutates actual source and command inputs, and pins deterministic blockers for malformed, unsupported, wrong-case, stale-source, stale-implementation, mismatched-command, non-zero-exit, and zero-assertion evidence. No known_failure waiver can mask regressions.
